picks.title: ชาวต่างชาติ พลัดตกชั้น 29 คอนโดหรูย่านนาเกลือ จ.ชลบุรี ร่างกระแทกพื้นดับสลด
picks.memo: 03:06 on Oct 28 a foreign man fell from the 29th floor of a condo on Sukhumvit Rd, Naklua, Bang Lamung (Chonburi) and died; Bang Lamung police investigating (CCTV).

picks.title: บุกพังบ้านสัตหีบคืบ! 3 ผู้เกี่ยวข้องพบตำรวจ โดน 5 ข้อหา ปมขัดแย้งส่วนตัว ครอบครัวผวาไม่กล้ากลับบ้าน
picks.memo: Follow-up (new facts) to the Sattahip house-smashing case: 3 people involved reported to police and face 5 charges incl. trespass, property damage, firearms offences; motive personal conflict; family still afraid to return home.

picks.title: High tides flood Bang Saen and Mae Klong as eight areas face warning
picks.memo: On Oct 28 high tides actually flooded parts of Bang Saen Beach (Chonburi), Mae Klong and Samut Prakan; Bangkok and 7 provinces told to prepare through Oct 30.

picks.title: ผงะ! พบกองขยะมหึมากว่า 10 ไร่ ริมมอเตอร์เวย์พัทยา–มาบตาพุด ลักลอบทิ้งกากอุตสาหกรรม-ขยะอิเล็กทรอนิกส์
picks.memo: Dump over 10 rai near the Pattaya–Map Ta Phut motorway, Bang Lamung; trucks allegedly dumped industrial waste and e-waste, reportedly hundreds of tonnes buried; Nong Prue mayor ordered officials to act.

picks.title: เจาะลึกเขตส่งเสริม EEC ใหม่ ‘อีเทค สมาร์ท พาร์ค’ 2 หมื่นล้าน ดึงบิ๊กเทคตั้งฐาน
picks.memo: EEC board approved new special promotion zone 'eTech Smart Park' in Chonburi, investment nearly 20 billion baht, for hi-tech industries (auto, electronics, aviation, medical).

picks.title: Watch your step, wear your life jacket, Pattaya Tourist Police remind Koh Larn visitors
picks.memo: Oct 26 Pattaya Tourist Police escorted passengers boarding boats to Koh Larn and checked they wore life jackets.

picks.title: Pattaya residents ask why illegal beach mat rentals keep returning daily
picks.memo: Pattaya municipal officers keep seizing mats and chairs rented to tourists without permission on Pattaya Beach; residents ask why it keeps coming back despite enforcement.

picks.title: Pattaya reviews marathon traffic plan to reduce disruption for residents and businesses
picks.memo: Deputy Mayor Krisana Boonsawat presented a review of the 33rd Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon 2026; traffic management to be changed for future editions to reduce disruption.

picks.title: Thai police expose alleged citizenship network involving 24 children and eight hospitals
picks.memo: Police and Dept of Provincial Administration seek 46 arrest warrants in 3rd phase of probe into Thai men falsely registered as fathers of children of foreign mothers to get Thai citizenship; 24 children, 8 hospitals. Bangkok governor Chadchart (Oct 28) ordered strict checks on child-legitimation registration and rotation of officials.

picks.title: Israeli Woman Blacklisted From Thailand For Bad Behavior
picks.memo: Immigration cancelled the stay permit of a 33-year-old Israeli visitor on Koh Pha Ngan after repeated disturbance complaints from residents/businesses; faces deportation and blacklisting.

picks.title: ตม.แม่สอดผนึกทหารราชมนูสกัดกระบะต้องสงสัย รวบชาวจีนลอบเข้าเมืองพร้อมคนไทยรับพาเข้าพื้นที่
picks.memo: Mae Sot immigration with army stopped a pickup: Chinese national's passport had no Thai entry stamp (said he crossed the Moei River back from Myanmar); Thai driver accused of helping an illegal alien.

picks.title: ปภ.-ออมสิน โอนเงินเยียวยาวันนี้ 393.86 ล้านบาท ช่วย 57,431 ครัวเรือน ครอบคลุม 15 จังหวัดและ กทม. เช็กสิทธิเลย!
picks.memo: Oct 28 DDPM and GSB transfer 393.86 million baht flood relief to 57,431 households in 15 provinces and Bangkok.

picks.title: Thai transwoman held for stabbing postgraduate student with scissors
picks.memo: Metropolitan Police Division 5 arrested a suspect on Oct 27 evening for stabbing a postgraduate student with scissors near a university in Asok, Bangkok; victim had sought help publicly.

picks.title: 4 คนงานก่อสร้างคู่ผัวเมีย ฉุน รุมตี-แทง นายจ้างชาวจีน เสียชีวิตในไซต์งานย่านลาดกระบัง
picks.memo: 20:00 Oct 27 a Chinese employer was beaten and stabbed to death at a workers' camp, Soi Phatthana Chonnabot 3, Lat Krabang, Bangkok; 4 construction workers (2 couples) involved.

picks.title: สั่งด่วนตำรวจจราจรทั่วประเทศ ห้ามสวมโม่งคลุมหน้า ห้ามบีบจ่ายค่าปรับที่ด่าน
picks.memo: Royal Thai Police traffic centre urgent order nationwide: traffic police must not wear face-covering balaclavas at checks, should warn first-time offenders, and must not pressure people to pay fines at checkpoints.

picks.title: TMD postpones winter announcement and predicts more rain in south
picks.memo: TMD had forecast (Oct 15) cold season from 3rd week of October to mid-Feb 2027, but postponed the official announcement as temperatures remain too high; heavy rain continues in the south.

picks.title: Floods affect 6,870 people in three provinces
picks.memo: DDPM: flooding remained in Kanchanaburi, Ratchaburi and Satun on Oct 28 morning, affecting 3,128 families / 6,870 people in 86 villages.

picks.title: ของเก่ายังเคลียร์ไม่หมดน้ำท่วมดินสไลน์ป่าตอง ของใหม่จ่อเข้ามาอีกแล้ว หลังภูเก็ตฝนตกหนักต่อเนื่อง
picks.memo: After all-night rain, run-off again flooded roads/homes in Na Nai community, Patong (Phuket) before earlier damage was cleared; landslide fears, 24-hour watch. Govt says Phuket flood/landslide victims qualify for disaster insurance payouts.

picks.title: Bangkok Bar Show Awards and Thailand’s 20 Best Bars 2026 announced
picks.memo: Oct 26 at Sindhorn Kempinski: Dry Wave Cocktail Studio No.1 on Thailand's 20 Best Bars for 3rd straight year; BKK Social Club (Four Seasons Chao Phraya) No.2, Bar Us No.3.

picks.title: TAT welcomes Air India Express’ inaugural Visakhapatnam–Bangkok flight
picks.memo: TAT welcomed Air India Express' inaugural Visakhapatnam–Bangkok flight (new India route).

picks.title: Cop raids smash mule account ring
picks.memo: Police arrested 11 suspects in nationwide crackdown on a transnational network creating and selling corporate mule accounts (via more than 1,500 companies) to scam gangs, launderers and online gambling.

picks.title: Pair held over illegal stroke-risk scans
picks.memo: Two arrested for unlicensed medical services incl. ultrasound stroke-risk scans at a restaurant in Bang Na, Bangkok, charging 900 baht per customer.

picks.title: Taobao adds PromptPay at checkout in local push
picks.memo: Taobao Tmall World adds PromptPay checkout in baht for Thai users; Thailand is its fastest-growing overseas market by user base.

picks.title: Soldiers Seize 4M Meth Pills in Chiang Rai Border Clash
picks.memo: About 20:30 Oct 26, soldiers clashed with smugglers at Pha Taek village on the Thai–Myanmar border in Chiang Rai and seized about 4 million meth pills.
